items.title: Wheat Motif Biscuit Stamp
items.alt: A wooden baking stamp with a carved wheat-ear motif rests beside a round biscuit with a matching impression and one wheat sprig.
items.description: A wooden baking stamp with a carved wheat-ear motif rests beside a round biscuit with a matching impression and one wheat sprig. The matching motif links the stamp and biscuit in a personal baking-craft illustration.

items.title: Grain Windmill with Wheat
items.alt: A wooden post windmill has four lattice sails, a side ladder and a compact patch of ripe wheat at its base.
items.description: A wooden post windmill has four lattice sails, a side ladder and a compact patch of ripe wheat at its base. Use the complete sails and building for a small historical grain-milling display.

items.title: Binding Wheat Coloring Illustration
items.alt: A kneeling farmer with a braided ponytail and tied headscarf binds a cut wheat bundle with twine, wearing a long apron and boots.
items.description: A kneeling farmer with a braided ponytail and tied headscarf binds a cut wheat bundle with twine, wearing a long apron and boots. Color the headscarf, apron and tied bundle separately in a classroom harvest activity.

items.title: Wheat Grain Scale Coloring Illustration
items.alt: A tabletop grain scale supports a shallow tray of wheat kernels beneath a blank raised display, with one wheat head beside its base.
items.description: A tabletop grain scale supports a shallow tray of wheat kernels beneath a blank raised display, with one wheat head beside its base. Add your own measurement prompt beside the blank display in a classroom worksheet.

items.title: Rolling Pasta Dough Coloring Illustration
items.alt: A curly-haired baker in a shirt and apron rolls a sheet of dough at a small table with wheat on its lower shelf.
items.description: A curly-haired baker in a shirt and apron rolls a sheet of dough at a small table with wheat on its lower shelf. The full table and baker suit a food-process coloring page.

items.title: Wheat Storage Coloring Illustration
items.alt: A cylindrical grain silo with a conical roof, ladder and lower hopper stands beside a small wheat-filled grain trailer.
items.description: A cylindrical grain silo with a conical roof, ladder and lower hopper stands beside a small wheat-filled grain trailer. Use the storage building and trailer in a farm-vocabulary coloring activity.
